text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon and Narita Brian both ran 
great races, though.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"...Didn't manage to take 1st, but man, 
Narita Brian really is on a whole other 
level."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The sheer intensity when she runs is 
just...! She really feels like a monster, 
doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...! Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my all! I ran my absolute best 
race! And yet...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(I was overwhelmed... by "Narita Brian's" 
sheer fighting spirit...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Son of a bitch...!

Without even a post-race interview like at 
the Shuka Sho, Hishi Amazon's Arima Kinen 
came to an end—

After that, Hishi Amazon simply said, "I'm 
heading back first," and left the 
racecourse.

Hishi Amazon is a strong-willed Umamusume. 
Even so—

I've waited for this day, and I've staked 
everything on it. That much is certain.

A flicker of unease crossed my mind, and I 
hurried back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Hnnnnyyyaaaarrrrgh!!

Upon arriving at the academy, a familiar 
roar echoed all around.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah, phew...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I still wasn't nearly good enough! But—so 
what?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll just run again! And blow right 
past them!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You never know how the next match'll go 
until you try!

Shouting as if to convince herself, she 
sprinted up the uphill slope.
choice_data_list:
(These words... I feel like I've heard 
them somewhere before—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as anything being 
impossible from the start!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You never know the outcome of a match 
until you give it a shot...!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp, wheeze*...! *phew*...!

Those were the words she said before I 
scouted her, if I remember correctly. 
Captivated by that straightforwardness, I 
decided to scout her.
choice_data_list:
(She hasn't changed at all since back 
then.)

text_block_list.text:
No matter what reality she faces, she has 
the strength to keep on fighting.
—If so, there was only one thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more set...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Trainy!? When did you...
choice_data_list:
Let's run in the Arima Kinen next year, 
too!

text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian will surely run in the Arima 
Kinen again next year.

"Let's definitely take 1st place next 
year. Hishi Amazon, next time you can do 
it, without fail!" When I told her that—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Train-boy, you...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Heheh, yeah!! Thanks a bunch!

Afterward, I talked it over with Hishi 
Amazon, and taking into account the 
aptitude for mile and middle distances she 
showed on the Tiara route—

We set our next target race as the Osaka 
Hai, and the one after that as the Yasuda 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Train-boy. This is just a selfish 
request of mine, but..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll take 1st place in both, without fail. 
I won't accept anything less!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Without that kind of resolve, you won't 
stand a chance against that "Monster," 
Narita Brian. Am I right?

Both resolved to take on the challenge 
with their eyes set solely on 1st 
place...!
